name: chw_plant_reset
description: Chilled-water plant reset. Keep one reset value between 0 and 1 and drive two plant setpoints from it: at 1 the plant runs at design (coldest supply water, highest differential pressure); lower values first let the supply water warm, then lower the pressure. While the plant is disabled the reset value is 1, effective immediately. After the plant is enabled the value stays at 1 until the start delay plus one update period has passed; this delay starts again at every re-enable. The value only changes at multiples of the update period counted from time 0. At each update read the number of requests: if it is greater than the ignored count, the change is the trim plus respond_amount for each request above the ignored count, with that respond part limited to respond_cap; otherwise the change is just the trim. Add the change to the value from the previous update and keep the result between 0 and 1. When chiller staging starts, freeze the value for at least staging_hold, or for as long as staging lasts if that is longer. The supply temperature setpoint is the warmest temperature when the reset value is 0.5 or lower and moves linearly to the design temperature at 1. The pressure setpoint is the lowest pressure at 0 and moves linearly to the design pressure at 0.5, staying there above 0.5. Timing at the edges, with the default values: if the plant is enabled at 0 s, the first change is applied by the update at 1,200 s itself. The request count used at an update is the count present at that update instant, including a change that happens at that same instant. An update at the very instant staging starts is already frozen: with staging from 3,000 s to 3,600 s, the updates at 3,000, 3,300 and 3,600 s change nothing, and the update at 3,900 s applies normally. The value carried from one update to the next is the value after that update's clamp, so it needs a stored copy that only changes at updates; computing it in a direct loop without that stored copy is not allowed.

inputs.name: nReqRes
inputs.meaning: Number of chilled-water reset requests from the air handlers

inputs.name: u1StaPro
inputs.meaning: A chiller staging change is in progress

params.name: design_supply_temperature
params.meaning: Supply temperature setpoint at a reset value of 1

params.name: warmest_supply_temperature
params.meaning: Supply temperature setpoint at a reset value of 0.5 or lower

params.name: design_pressure
params.meaning: Pressure setpoint at a reset value of 0.5 or higher

params.name: lowest_pressure
params.meaning: Pressure setpoint at a reset value of 0

params.name: start_delay
params.meaning: Wait after enable, before the extra update period, before any change

params.name: update_period
params.meaning: The reset value changes only at multiples of this period

params.name: ignored_requests
params.meaning: Request counts up to this value do not count

params.name: trim
params.meaning: Change per update when not responding, and part of every change

params.name: respond_amount
params.meaning: Added per request above the ignored count

params.name: respond_cap
params.meaning: Largest total the respond part may add in one update

params.name: staging_hold
params.meaning: Minimum time updates stay frozen after staging starts
